turns_text: [SEG0001] person_1 (DOCTOR): Sorry, one minute, this screen has frozen again. Right, it is moving. What brings you in today?
[SEG0002] person_2 (PATIENT): Doctor, I am feeling very tired only. From many months it is there, but from exactly when, I don't know.
[SEG0003] person_1 (DOCTOR): Tiredness. For how long? Please say that again, I was looking at the monitor.
[SEG0004] person_2 (PATIENT): I don't know, doctor. Maybe since Diwali, or after. Or last winter, or the one before. I cannot fix a date.
[SEG0005] person_1 (DOCTOR): So some months, start date unclear. The old notes are not opening. What else?
[SEG0006] person_2 (PATIENT): I feel cold also. My husband says the room is warm, and still I am sitting with a shawl. At the showroom I keep the cardigan on the whole day.
[SEG0007] person_1 (DOCTOR): Sorry, the cardigan part. You feel cold the whole day, is that what you said?
[SEG0008] person_2 (PATIENT): Yes, doctor. Whole day, mostly. Others in the office are comfortable only.
[SEG0009] person_1 (DOCTOR): Has your weight changed?
[SEG0010] person_2 (PATIENT): It has gone up, I think. My salwar is tight at the waist. How many kilos I don't know, doctor. I did not check.
[SEG0011] person_1 (DOCTOR): And the bowels, are they daily?
[SEG0012] person_2 (PATIENT): No. Every two days... well, actually every second or third day. Stool is hard, and I have to strain.
[SEG0013] person_1 (DOCTOR): Every second or third day, hard, with straining. I want to be sure I heard that over the fan. Has that been for the same period?
[SEG0014] person_2 (PATIENT): I think the same time as the tiredness. But I don't know, doctor. I cannot say which month.
[SEG0015] person_1 (DOCTOR): How is the mood?
[SEG0016] person_2 (PATIENT): Low only, not crying-crying, but no interest to do anything. I am putting it on the work and my age, and I am forty-eight. What else can it be, doctor? I don't know.
[SEG0017] person_1 (DOCTOR): Forty-eight. What work is that? One second, I have to clear this pop-up.
[SEG0018] person_2 (PATIENT): Accounts, in a garments showroom near the market. Long hours, sitting only. Evening time I am completely finished, I don't feel like cooking also.
[SEG0019] person_1 (DOCTOR): You feel the job and getting older explain the whole thing.
[SEG0020] person_2 (PATIENT): Yes, what else, doctor? I don't know. After forty everyone is getting tired, no? My sister was also saying that on the phone, but she is alright, she just likes to talk.
[SEG0021] person_1 (DOCTOR): Not everyone. Is there thyroid disease in the family? The history page is blank, so I am asking fresh.
[SEG0022] person_2 (PATIENT): My mother had it. Thyroid disease, and she took tablets for many years. Hypo or the other one, I don't know, doctor. They just said thyroid.
[SEG0023] person_1 (DOCTOR): Mother, thyroid disease, on tablets many years, type unknown. Did you ever have a thyroid test?
[SEG0024] person_2 (PATIENT): Once only, some time back. They said it was borderline. No tablets were started.
[SEG0025] person_1 (DOCTOR): Can you repeat that result? This window just refreshed and I lost the sentence.
[SEG0026] person_2 (PATIENT): Borderline, they said. I don't remember any number, doctor. They said it was borderline and medicine was not needed. I don't have the report.
[SEG0027] person_1 (DOCTOR): When was that test?
[SEG0028] person_2 (PATIENT): I don't know, doctor. I cannot date it. Last... no, I should not guess. If I say a year it will be wrong only.
[SEG0029] person_1 (DOCTOR): We will leave the year blank. Are you taking any tablets these days, even for pain or sleep?
[SEG0030] person_2 (PATIENT): No, doctor. Nothing from the pharmacy. Sometimes jeera water for gas, that is home remedy only, not a medicine.
[SEG0031] person_1 (DOCTOR): Any chest pain, or breathlessness on walking?
[SEG0032] person_2 (PATIENT): No chest pain. Breathing is normal. I am slow, that is all.
[SEG0033] person_1 (DOCTOR): Any fever?
[SEG0034] person_2 (PATIENT): No fever, doctor.
[SEG0035] person_1 (DOCTOR): Is the hair falling more, or the skin newly dry? I should have asked before the screen distracted me.
[SEG0036] person_2 (PATIENT): No. Hair is the same only. Skin is not more dry than my usual. On the bus I was thinking maybe, but no, it is not.
[SEG0037] person_1 (DOCTOR): Let me feel the front of the neck. Look ahead. Sorry, the glove caught.
[SEG0038] person_1 (DOCTOR): The gland is not enlarged. Your hands are cool. Pulse is regular, I make it about seventy-two a minute.
[SEG0039] person_2 (PATIENT): Seventy-two is okay, no? I was thinking it would be very slow.

[SEG0040] person_1 (DOCTOR): That rate is acceptable, and it does not settle the question. My working impression is a possible underactive thyroid, but I cannot confirm it without bloods. It may still turn out to be the workload, though the cold and the constipation pull me towards the thyroid.
[SEG0041] person_2 (PATIENT): Underactive, meaning that borderline has become a proper disease? I don't know, doctor. I always thought borderline means it is normal only.

[SEG0042] person_1 (DOCTOR): No. What they told you is not a figure I can rely on, and it is old. I am arranging a fresh thyroid blood test, TSH and free T4, plus a full blood count for the tiredness.
[SEG0043] person_2 (PATIENT): Can I do it today? I took tea in the morning, is that a problem? I don't know these rules.
[SEG0044] person_1 (DOCTOR): Tea is fine, fasting is not needed. Go to the lab downstairs after this, today itself. They will take both.
[SEG0045] person_2 (PATIENT): Okay. The old report, should I search the cupboard? It may be there, it may not. I really don't know.
[SEG0046] person_1 (DOCTOR): If you find it, bring it when you come back. If not, leave it. And don't settle it in your mind as only age and long hours until we see these results.
[SEG0047] person_2 (PATIENT): The low feeling also, you are saying that can be the thyroid? Sometimes I think I am just bored of the showroom.
[SEG0048] person_1 (DOCTOR): It can travel with an underactive thyroid. I am not diagnosing depression in this visit. Come back in two weeks for the results, even if you feel a bit better by then.
[SEG0049] person_2 (PATIENT): Two weeks, yes. I will go to the lab now. Sorry I was late, the parking on this road is a full headache today.
